description: Metadata for public European Digital Rights pages about artificial intelligence and technology. Hosts are edri.org and www.edri.org. Each stored row was confirmed with one bounded robots-allowed HTML GET that stayed on those hosts. www.edri.org redirects to edri.org. Rows keep title, publisher, canonical URL, date, and rights. Page text is not stored. creative_commons_attribution is CC BY alone. creative_commons is CC0, CC BY-SA, or a permissive mix. A missing publication date is unknown. Updated, modified, and copyright years are not publication dates. Donation, login, and unrelated topics are omitted. Not a belief collector. runner_wired stays false.
